common.reserveFlat: The largest gap is by {{hour}} - {{kwh}} kWh before the panels catch up. Consumption spread evenly until an hourly profile is collected.

dashboard.error: Failed to fetch status from the backend.
dashboard.noDecision: No decision yet. The first one runs at its scheduled time, or run one below.
dashboard.chargeOn: Reserve {{targetSoc}}%, from the grid if needed
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.dialLabel: Battery at {{soc}}%. The dial shows the day with the cheap tariff windows.

decidesFor.OVERNIGHT: Whether to charge from the grid overnight
decidesFor.AFTERNOON: Whether to top up from the grid this afternoon
decidesFor.RECHECK: Recalculates the night with a fresher forecast

dashboard.runHint: Recalculates the decision for a window from the current forecast and writes it to the inverter straight away.
dashboard.stale: The last decision was made {{time}} - over a day ago. The scheduled jobs don't seem to be running, and the inverter is on an old plan.

issue.DECISION_FAILED: The {{window}} decision at {{time}} failed despite retries - the inverter kept its previous schedule.
issue.SCHEDULE_MISMATCH: Read back after writing at {{time}}, the {{window}} slots didn't match the decision, even after rewriting. Check the inverter schedule.
issue.FORECAST_UNAVAILABLE: At {{time}} there was no PV forecast - the {{window}} decision was made as if no sun was coming.

history.title: Decision history
history.empty: No decisions in the last 7 days.
history.subtitle: Every charging decision from the last 7 days, newest first.

outcome.label: Outcome in the expensive hours:
outcome.soc: Battery at the start and at the end

touSchedule.title: Inverter schedule
touSchedule.subtitle: The six Time-of-Use slots currently stored in the inverter. The app sets two of them; the rest are fixed.
touSchedule.error: Failed to fetch the TOU schedule from the inverter.

settings.title: Process settings
settings.subtitle: Everything the planner needs. Changes apply immediately, decision times included.
settings.notConfiguredBanner: The process isn't configured yet. Fill in the form and save. Until then, scheduled decisions are skipped.
settings.saved: Saved. Decisions will run at the new times.

planning.title: Planning policy
planning.hint: Battery capacity and thresholds, and consumption in the expensive hours. Each decision weighs that consumption against the forecast for the same hours.
planning.consumptionAfterOvernightHint: In the expensive hours after the overnight window (6–13)
planning.consumptionAfterAfternoonHint: In the expensive hours after the afternoon window (15–22)
planning.learned: Measured: {{kwh}} kWh, averaged over {{samples}} days. Planning uses this instead of the value entered.
planning.batteryCapacityHint: The full capacity, matching 0–100% SOC. Don't subtract the minimum SOC - the reserve is counted on top of it.

schedule.title: Daily schedule
schedule.hint: When each of the two daily decisions runs. Ideally a quarter of an hour before its cheap window starts.
schedule.overnightRecheckHint: A second overnight decision, inside the cheap window, with a fresher forecast. Leave empty to turn off.

forecast.title: PV production forecast
forecast.directionsHint: Where the installation is, and one panel plane per compass direction. 0 kWp means there are no panels facing that way.

inverter.title: Inverter connection
inverter.hint: The inverter's address on the home network and the logger serial number. Stored only in the local database.

settings.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields and save again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: An alert on your phone when a decision fails, the inverter doesn't take the schedule, or there's no forecast. Install the ntfy app, pick a hard-to-guess topic and paste its address.
notifications.testDelivered: Sent - it should be on your phone now.
notifications.testFailed: Couldn't send it. Check the topic address.

reason.ALREADY_AT_TARGET_SOC: The battery already holds at least {{targetSoc}}%, enough for what the sun won't cover - skipping grid charging.
reason.BELOW_MIN_SOC: SOC ({{soc}}%) is below the safety minimum ({{minSoc}}%) - charging from the grid regardless of forecast.
reason.FORECAST_SUFFICIENT: Production forecast ({{forecastKwh}} kWh) covers estimated consumption with margin (required {{requiredKwh}} kWh) - skipping grid charging.
reason.FORECAST_INSUFFICIENT: The forecast for the expensive hours is {{forecastKwh}} kWh against {{requiredKwh}} kWh of consumption, and the sun won't cover it all in time. So during the cheap window the battery keeps at least {{targetSoc}}%. If it has less, the inverter tops it up from the grid - only to that level.
reason.RESERVE_HELD: The battery ({{soc}}%) already holds enough for the expensive hours ({{targetSoc}}% needed, forecast {{forecastKwh}} kWh against {{requiredKwh}} kWh required). No grid charge, but it won't drop below {{targetSoc}}% during the cheap hours - the house runs on the cheap grid meanwhile.
